sections.title: 1. Data Controller
paragraphs: In cloud mode (app.glassfolio.dev), the data controller is the GlassFolio publisher (see Legal Notice), reachable at {{email}}. No Data Protection Officer (DPO) is appointed, as appointment is not mandatory for this processing.
In self-hosted mode (local Docker container), no data is sent to the publisher: you alone are responsible for the data stored on your machine.

sections.title: 1 bis. Client-Side End-to-End Encrypted (E2EE) Architecture
paragraphs: GlassFolio is designed from the ground up around the end-to-end encryption (E2EE) paradigm. All your sensitive financial data (transactions, holdings, unit cost basis, tax declarations, goals and private AI API keys) is encrypted directly in your browser memory through the WebCrypto API using AES-256-GCM. Key derivation relies on PBKDF2-SHA256 (600,000 iterations) and HKDF-SHA256.

callout.text: Crucially, no financial data is ever exposed in plaintext. Your plaintext financial data, master password, recovery key and TOTP secrets are never transmitted in clear to any third party nor accessible to administrators.

sections.title: 2. Data Processed
paragraphs: Cloud mode — data we process to run your account:
items: Account identity: email address, display name, technical identifier, sign-in method (email or Google).
Security data: two-factor authentication factors (TOTP, passkeys) and authentication logs kept by Supabase (sign-in dates, IP address, browser).
Encrypted vault: vault header (salt, derivation parameters) and encrypted envelopes holding your financial data, unreadable on the server side.
Interface preferences (theme, language) stored locally in your browser.
Local mode (Docker): none of this data leaves your machine.

sections.title: 3. Purposes and Legal Bases
items: Create and manage your account, sync your encrypted vault: performance of the contract formed by the Terms of Use (Art. 6.1.b GDPR).
Send transactional emails (verification code, confirmation link, security notifications): performance of the contract (Art. 6.1.b).
Secure the service (strong authentication, abuse limiting, authentication logs): legitimate interest in protecting accounts (Art. 6.1.f).

Optional anonymous audience measurement (Vercel Web Analytics, cookieless: page views, country, device and browser type): only with your consent (Art. 6.1.a), which you can withdraw at any time. Never loaded in self-hosted mode.
Comply with legal obligations and handle your rights requests (Art. 6.1.c).
No automated decision producing legal effects is made; the AI assistant provides non-decisional information.

sections.title: 4. Recipients and Processors
paragraphs: Your data is neither sold nor rented. It is processed by the following technical providers, strictly to operate the service:

sections.title: 5. Server Location and Transfers Outside the European Union
paragraphs: Your account data and encrypted envelopes are stored in the European Union (Supabase, Ireland). Application hosting (Vercel, Dublin) and email delivery (Resend, Ireland) are also configured in the Ireland region; only the site's static files are delivered by a global CDN.

Server location alone does not rule out every transfer, however: Supabase, Vercel, Resend, GitHub and Google are companies established in the United States, whose staff may access data from that country (support, administration). These accesses rely on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework adequacy decision or on the European Commission standard contractual clauses, depending on the provider. Because vault data is end-to-end encrypted in your browser, no provider receives your financial data in clear.

sections.title: 6. External Network Calls & Market Data
paragraphs: To provide live portfolio valuations and AI capabilities, your browser may establish direct network connections to the following endpoints:
items: Yahoo Finance & CoinGecko: Direct HTTP requests from your browser for real-time market prices and currency exchange rates (locally cached with a 15-minute TTL). These services receive your IP address, not your positions.

User-Configured AI Providers: If you configure a personal API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, OpenRouter), requests are sent directly from your browser to the selected provider, under its own terms. Alternatively, you can use Ollama locally for 100% offline AI assistance with no data leakage.

Static resources: Tailwind CSS is loaded from cdn.tailwindcss.com, which transmits your IP address and browser to that CDN. No portfolio data is shared. The Inter font is hosted by GlassFolio and calls no Google service.

sections.title: 7. Retention Periods
items: Account and encrypted data: kept as long as your account exists, deleted when the account is deleted.
Unfinished sign-ups (unconfirmed email or vault not created): automatically purged after 24 hours.
Technical authentication and email-delivery logs: kept by Supabase and Resend for service security, for a limited period set by each provider.
Backups: after deletion, encrypted copies may remain with the host until the end of their rotation cycle, then are permanently erased.
Cookie consent choice: 13 months maximum, then asked again.
Local mode: until you purge the vault or delete the Docker volume.

sections.title: 8. GDPR Rights & Data Portability
paragraphs: In accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and the French Data Protection Act, you have full sovereignty over your data. Every request is answered within one month; if there is reasonable doubt about your identity, proof of identity may be requested.
items: Right of access and portability (Art. 15 and 20): export a ZIP archive (profile, consent, JSON backup and CSVs) at any time from Settings > Data & Backups. The demo account holds no personal data and cannot be exported.
Right to rectification (Art. 16): edit your name, email and preferences from Settings > Profile.

Right to erasure (Art. 17): "Delete my account" in Settings > Data & Backups permanently erases your account, your encrypted data on our servers and the local data on this device (a security confirmation is required). The "Purge vault" action only clears this device.
Rights to restriction and objection (Art. 18 and 21) and withdrawal of consent (Art. 7): write to {{email}} or manage your consent in the Cookies tab.
Directives on what happens to your data after your death: write to {{email}}.
Right to lodge a complaint: You have the right to lodge a complaint with the French supervisory authority, the CNIL (Commission Nationale de l'Informatique et des Libertés — www.cnil.fr).

sections.title: 9. Security
paragraphs: Client-side AES-256-GCM encryption, TLS connections, per-user database isolation (Row Level Security), two-factor authentication (TOTP, passkeys) and strengthened confirmation for sensitive actions (export, email change, account deletion). End-to-end encryption means that if you lose both your master password and your recovery key, your data is permanently unrecoverable, including by the publisher.

sections.title: 10. Cookies and Local Storage
paragraphs: GlassFolio uses no tracking cookie. The full inventory of local storage and the management of your consent are in the "Cookies & Storage" tab.

sections.title: 11. Minors
paragraphs: The service is reserved for adults (18 years or older). We do not knowingly collect data from minors; if you believe a minor created an account, write to {{email}} to have it deleted.

sections.title: 12. Changes to this Policy
paragraphs: This policy may change. The date and version appear at the top of the page; for significant changes, you will be informed in the application.

sections.title: 1. Purpose and Acceptance
paragraphs: These terms govern the free use of GlassFolio (showcase site, cloud application and self-hosted version). By creating an account or using the application, you declare that you have read and accepted them.

sections.title: 2. Description of the Service
paragraphs: GlassFolio is a wealth-tracking dashboard: entering or importing transactions, positions, goals, tax simulations and an AI assistant. It runs in cloud mode (account and encrypted sync) or in self-hosted local mode.

sections.title: 3. Eligibility
paragraphs: The service is reserved for adults (18 years or older) with the legal capacity to enter into agreements.

sections.title: 4. Account, Master Password and Recovery Key
paragraphs: You are responsible for the confidentiality of your credentials. End-to-end encryption means the publisher can neither read your data, nor recover your master password, nor reset it.

callout.text: Keep your recovery key in a safe place. If you lose both your master password and your recovery key, your data is permanently inaccessible and no recovery is possible.

sections.title: 5. Non-Financial & Non-Tax Advice Disclaimer (AMF / DGFiP)
paragraphs: Tax simulations (30% flat tax vs progressive scale Box 2OP, Cerfa forms 2042 / 2074 / 3916) and ETF fee erosion projections are computed from user-entered data and known legal brackets. The user remains solely responsible for verifying official declarations with the DGFiP or a qualified professional (chartered accountant, tax lawyer).

callout.text: GlassFolio is strictly a software demonstration and mathematical simulation tool for informational purposes. It DOES NOT PROVIDE certified financial investment advice (CIF), portfolio management services for third parties, nor tax or legal advice within the meaning of French and European regulations.

sections.title: 6. Market Data, Calculations and AI Assistant
paragraphs: Prices and exchange rates come from third-party sources and may be delayed, incomplete or wrong. AI assistant answers may contain errors and never constitute a recommendation. If you use your own API key (BYOK), its use and billing fall under your contract with the chosen provider.

sections.title: 7. Acceptable Use
paragraphs: You must not undermine the security or operation of the service, automate it abusively, attempt to access other people's data, or exploit it commercially (see article 8).

sections.title: 8. Intellectual Property and License

Any monetization, of the original or of a modified version, is prohibited, and intellectual property remains with the author. Proposed contributions are accepted under these same conditions.

sections.title: 9. Service Availability
paragraphs: The service is free and provided without any availability guarantee. It may be interrupted for maintenance, evolve or stop. If cloud mode is closed, reasonable notice will be given so that you can export your data.

sections.title: 10. Software Provided "As-Is" and Liability
paragraphs: GlassFolio is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind, express or implied. The author and contributors shall not be liable for calculation discrepancies, delayed stock quotes, data loss or investment decisions made based on the software, within the limits permitted by law. Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot legally be excluded (willful misconduct, gross negligence, mandatory consumer rights).

sections.title: 11. Termination and Deletion
paragraphs: You can delete your account at any time from Settings > Data & Backups. The publisher may suspend an account in case of abuse or risk to the security of the service.

sections.title: 12. Changes to the Terms

cookies.title: Cookies & Local Storage Inventory
cookies.overviewText: GlassFolio uses NO third-party tracking cookies or advertising pixels. All client-side persisted data is managed through the browser local storage under strict cryptographic segmentation; the keys listed below are the only ones written.

vaultHeader.purpose: Stores the PBKDF2 salt, auth verification tag, and passkey PRF metadata. Contains no financial values.

vaultPayload.purpose: AES-256-GCM encrypted financial ledger records (transactions, positions, goals, AI secrets). Only readable with your master key in RAM.

themeLang.purpose: Stores your chosen UI theme (Light, Dark, Midnight) and language preference (EN, FR) across sessions and between glassfolio.dev and app.glassfolio.dev.

consent.purpose: Stores your CNIL GDPR analytics consent record and timestamp.

supabaseSession.purpose: Keeps your cloud-mode sign-in session (Supabase tokens) so you do not have to sign in again. Absent in local mode.

oauthVerifier.purpose: Temporary security value (PKCE) during Google sign-in.

marketCaches.purpose: Locally caches public prices and exchange rates to limit network calls. Holds no personal data.

uiState.purpose: Sidebar state and the price history you enter manually.
uiState.lifespan: Persistent until account deletion or cache clearing

passkeyRpId.purpose: Remembers the domain (RP ID) your passkeys are bound to so the vault can be unlocked while locked. Public deployment metadata, no personal data.
passkeyRpId.lifespan: Until account deletion or cache clearing

accessibility.title: Accessibility Declaration (RGAA 4.1)
accessibility.statusText: GlassFolio strives to make its interface accessible according to the General Accessibility Improvement Framework (RGAA version 4.1 / WCAG 2.1 level AA). This declaration is made voluntarily. The application is currently PARTIALLY COMPLIANT, pending a formal external audit.
accessibility.featAria: Semantic Landmarks & ARIA: Proper semantic tags (header, nav, main, section, footer), accessible button labels (aria-label on all icon-only controls), and accordion controls (aria-expanded, aria-controls).
accessibility.featContrast: WCAG AA Color Contrast: Strict SSOT semantic token system enforcing minimum 4.5:1 text-to-background contrast across Light, Dark, and Midnight themes.
accessibility.featKeyboard: Keyboard Navigation: Visible focus outlines and tab sequence across all interactive controls, modals, and drawers.
accessibility.featMotion: Reduced Motion: Respects the user's operating system prefers-reduced-motion preference, disabling decorative transitions and animations.
accessibility.feedbackText: If you encounter an accessibility defect preventing access to content or a feature, write to {{email}} or open a ticket via https://github.com/Damien-Esilv.
